title: Nickname / diminutive sidecar
description: Given-name nickname-to-canonical lookup sidecar consumed by the Swift NameGazetteer boost path (search-impl S5, design 02 §7). Each key is a lowercase nickname or diminutive surface form; the value lists the canonical given names that form maps to, so a bloom miss on the surface form can be re-queried against its canonical forms. This is a standalone sidecar — it is not part of the signed bloom manifest and requires no bloom rebuild.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the shape changes in a way the Swift decoder must observe.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed recorded for reproducibility. Aggregation is not itself randomized; the field is included for uniformity with other gazetteer artifacts.

sources.description: Provenance records for every raw source folded into this artifact. Each entry carries the SHA-256 of the committed raw file and the retrieval date as documented in SOURCES.md.

id.description: Stable identifier resolving to a row in SOURCES.md.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw source file.

retrieval_date.description: ISO date on which the raw source was fetched.

entries.description: Nickname surface form (lowercase, NFKC-normalized) mapped to the sorted list of canonical given names it may stand for.
